title: Authenticated Request
description: GET http://127.0.0.1:18081/profile returns 401 Unauthorized without credentials.
mission: Read the provided credentials and make a successful request to /profile with the required Authorization header.
success: The API accepted an authenticated profile request.

files.content:
Profile URL: http://127.0.0.1:18081/profile
The API expects an Authorization header.

hints: Inspect credentials.txt and include both the scheme and token.
curl uses -H to add a request header.
The header format is: Authorization: Bearer <token>
